title: Daddy Gets Fit
hook: 猪爸爸肚子太大，跟着电视做俯卧撑，又骑佩奇的小自行车，累得不行。

cells.a: She is watching a keep fit programme on television.
cells.cn: 她在看电视上的健身节目。

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig say about Daddy Pig?
cells.a: She said he does not look fit and his tummy is big.
cells.cn: 她说他看起来不健康，肚子还挺大。

cells.q: What must Daddy Pig start doing?
cells.a: He has to start exercising now to get fit.
cells.cn: 他现在必须开始锻炼了。

cells.q: How many press-ups must he do?
cells.a: Mummy Pig wants him to do one hundred press-ups.
cells.cn: 猪妈妈让他做一百个俯卧撑。

cells.q: What is the rest of the family doing?
cells.a: They are in the kitchen making lunch while he exercises.
cells.cn: 他在锻炼时，其他人在厨房做午饭。

cells.q: Why did Daddy Pig stop exercising?
cells.a: Because there was something interesting on the TV.
cells.cn: 因为电视上有个有趣的节目。

cells.q: What did Peppa give Daddy Pig?
cells.a: She gave him her little bicycle to ride on.
cells.cn: 她把自己的小自行车给他骑。

cells.a: He had been gone a long time on the little bicycle.
cells.cn: 他骑着小自行车出去很久都没回来。

cells.q: What must Daddy Pig do tomorrow?
cells.a: He will have to do some more exercise tomorrow.

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: fit, exercise, tummy, press-ups, bicycle, tired
helper.actions: watch, touch, push, ride, make, rest

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Daddy Gets Fit”.
ending: In the end, Peppa will make sure Daddy keeps exercising. My favourite part is ______.
